public:
    static const int SIZE = 2000;
    int cnt, pos[SIZE], rev[SIZE];
    int gao(int n, vector<int> e[]) {
        cnt = 0;
        fill(pos, pos + SIZE, -1);
        fill(rev, rev + SIZE, -1);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            fill(v, v + SIZE, 0);

        return cnt;
    }

    int v[SIZE];
    bool match(int x, vector<int> e[]) {
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)e[x].size(); i++) {
            int y = e[x][i];
            if (v[y]) continue;
            v[y] = 1;
            if (rev[y] < 0 || match(rev[y], e)) {
                pos[x] = y;
                rev[y] = x;
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;

int dr[DIRS] = {0, -1, 0, 1};

class HungarianAlgorithm {
public:
    int matchCount;
    int pos[MAX_NODES], rev[MAX_NODES];
    bool visited[MAX_NODES];

    int computeMatching(int n, vector<int> adjList[]) {
        matchCount = 0;
        memset(pos, -1, sizeof(pos));
        memset(rev, -1, sizeof(rev));
        for (int u = 0; u < n; ++u) {
            memset(visited, 0, sizeof(visited));
            if (augment(u, adjList)) ++matchCount;
        }
        return matchCount;
    }

private:
    bool augment(int u, vector<int> adjList[]) {
        for (int v : adjList[u]) {
            if (visited[v]) continue;
            visited[v] = true;
            if (rev[v] == -1 || augment(rev[v], adjList)) {
                pos[u] = v;
                rev[v] = u;
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
};

void bfs(int sr, int sc, int n) {
    queue<int> qRow, qCol;

    qRow.push(sr); qCol.push(sc);
    dist[sr][sc] = 0;
    while (!qRow.empty()) {
        sr = qRow.front(); qRow.pop();
        sc = qCol.front(); qCol.pop();
        for (int d = 0; d < DIRS; ++d) {
            int nr = sr + dr[d], nc = sc + dc[d];
            if (nr >= 0 && nr < GRID_SIZE && nc >= 0 && nc < GRID_SIZE &&
                gridA[nr][nc] >= 0 && dist[nr][nc] < 0) {
                dist[nr][nc] = dist[sr][sc] + 1;
                qRow.push(nr); qCol.push(nc);
            }
        }
    }
}

void expand(int sr, int sc, int count, int maxTime, int &nodeOffset) {
    int visited[GRID_SIZE][GRID_SIZE];
    queue<int> qRow, qCol;
    memset(visited, -1, sizeof(visited));
    qRow.push(sr); qCol.push(sc);
    visited[sr][sc] = 0;
    while (!qRow.empty()) {
        sr = qRow.front(); qRow.pop();
        sc = qCol.front(); qCol.pop();
        if (visited[sr][sc] > min(maxTime, dist[sr][sc])) continue;
        for (int exitIdx : exitPoints[sr][sc]) {
            for (int k = 0; k < count; ++k) {

            }
        }
        if (visited[sr][sc] == min(maxTime, dist[sr][sc])) continue;
        for (int d = 0; d < DIRS; ++d) {
            int nr = sr + dr[d], nc = sc + dc[d];
            if (nr >= 0 && nr < GRID_SIZE && nc >= 0 && nc < GRID_SIZE &&
                gridA[nr][nc] >= 0 && visited[nr][nc] < 0) {
                visited[nr][nc] = visited[sr][sc] + 1;
